model_interpretation.claim: Both measured fused one-row candidates passed all eight cases; fixed four warps averaged 41.669 µs versus 42.155 µs for the adaptive 1/4/8-warps candidate. This experiment retains four warps below a 4096-element padded row and tests two warps for wider rows: fewer warps might reduce cross-warp coordination, though increased per-lane work could instead hurt. No speedup is assumed before measurement.

model_interpretation.claim: The two measured T2 grouped mappings are both correct and close in mean time (42.587 µs and 42.640 µs), so the available evidence does not establish a benefit from their row grouping. This candidate tests a more graduated, larger grouping—16 rows through padded width 128, 8 through 512, 4 through 2048, and 2 beyond—while choosing 8 warps for widths above 1024 to keep the per-thread tile bounded. items.subject: Intégration mesurée des mappings direct et groupé
items.objective: À partir du meilleur candidat T1, intégrer le noyau T2 à plusieurs lignes par CTA comme alternative sélectionnée selon des dimensions génériques, sans seuil calé sur les seules formes de test. Garder le noyau direct comme option pour les lignes larges; préserver le softmax stable, les masques de queue, la correction et les contraintes d’entrée/sortie, sans intermédiaire supplémentaire. Mesurer le programme intégré selon le protocole officiel.
